purpose: Proposed retrospective company filing-event price-return comparison with date-supported CIK-to-security identity and one documented primary issue; no historical tradability or economic-value claim

development_evidence_only.selection_policy: Do not select a dense setting using S2/S3 outcomes; use the pre-existing 128-body-token equal-chunk reference

time_interpretation.strict_alternative: Bind a contemporaneously available complete model-file revision, training-data cutoff evidence, decision-time text vintage and point-in-time market data before any as-of claim

current_missing_evidence.historical_security_master_reason: A bound 2020 acquisition security extract and histories exist; an eligible operating-common company master, dated CIK relation, primary issue and event market are unverified.
current_missing_evidence.decision_time_item1_vintage_reason: No formal original-accession, fiscal-period, Item 1 byte-version event manifest has been bound for this candidate.
current_missing_evidence.first_public_dissemination_reason: SEC filing and acceptance dates do not prove an exact first-public instant; a no-later-than source or an accepted proxy has not been selected for this design.
current_missing_evidence.complete_feature_and_label_price_reason: Eight source-bound Daily segments and saved derivation exist, but canonical trade-close, adjustment, exit and common event-mask contracts are not accepted.
current_missing_evidence.independent_session_calendar_reason: A retrospective XNYS baseline is saved; each issue's event-time listing market and applicable exchange calendar remain unverified.
current_missing_evidence.delisting_outcome_reason: Delisting candidates are saved, but terminal-outcome coverage and handling for the proposed cohort have not been accepted.
current_missing_evidence.dividend_manifest_reason: Distribution candidates are saved; the proposed price return excludes ordinary dividends and the treatment of other distributions is unresolved.
current_missing_evidence.global_model_training_cutoff_reason: The official model card does not establish a cutoff across all pretraining and fine-tuning sources
current_missing_evidence.approved_prediction_observation_count_re: No full H/R design, event mask, sample, text-vintage, price/exit policy or financial protocol has researcher acceptance.

sample.event_unit: one original 10-K Item 1 CIK/fiscal-period filing event with a date-valid CIK-security relation and one documented primary issue at the decision session
sample.planning_cohort: At most 200 distinct CIKs from a verified proposed 2020-01-01 US exchange-listed operating-common-share company master with dated primary security; retain later exits and identifier changes
sample.planning_cohort_hash_rule: sort ascending by SHA-256(UTF-8('m5-r7-2026-11-01:' + ten_digit_CIK)); take the first 200 after excluding the five development CIKs
sample.admission: Require original accession/fiscal period, exact Item 1 version, eligible dated company-primary security, applicable market calendar, exact text and finalized d-close availability by proposed 18:00 ET, full lookback/label windows and accepted exit treatment; retain every exclusion reason

decision_and_label.recommended_decision: 18:00 America/New_York on the first regular trading session strictly after the official filing date, conditional on proof that the exact text and finalized d close bar were available by 18:00; otherwise the event is ineligible with a recorded reason
decision_and_label.primary_label: split-adjusted closing-price return C(i,d+5)/C(i,d)-1, where d is the decision session; dividends are excluded
decision_and_label.label_available_after: close on d+5 and vendor finalization
decision_and_label.total_return_alternative: Require dividend, delisting and corporate-action data plus a prespecified reinvestment convention before claiming total return
decision_and_label.missing_or_delisted_label_policy: Null with reason; block a broad-cohort evaluation until a delisting outcome rule and source cover exits, or separately approve a narrower estimand with explicit exclusions; never zero-fill or silently select survivors

security_join.unit: one time-valid listed common-share security identifier per CIK filing event
security_join.recommended_rule: Require event-time dated CIK-to-security evidence and one sourced primary common-share issue for that CIK, plus dated listing market and identifier history; a unique CUSIP observation candidate is insufficient
security_join.multiple_candidate_rule: if multiple classes remain and no unique primary listing is documented, mark the event AMBIGUOUS_SECURITY and exclude it under the predeclared common mask; do not choose a class by future price coverage or realized label
security_join.alternative_rule: Unaccepted separate option: predecision 60-session dollar-volume ranking requires a complete predecision window, may fail early-2020 coverage, and changes security selection; do not activate automatically
security_join.delisting_rule: retain all CIK and security exit events; missing terminal prices do not become zeros or silently remove firms

decision_and_label.close_availability_rule: the exact decision-session close bar must have a source timestamp or accepted no-later-than evidence by 18:00 ET; absent evidence makes the event ineligible, not historically verified

shared_nontext: population standard deviation (ddof=0) of C(t)/C(t-1)-1 for the twenty regular sessions ending at d

lexical.representation: Item 1 train-only TF-IDF: lowercase [a-z][a-z0-9]+, raw term counts, top 5000 terms by training-document frequency with lexical ties, IDF log((1+N)/(1+df))+1, row L2 normalization, then 32 train-only SVD dimensions
lexical.fit_boundary: training documents only; refit on training plus validation before final test after hyperparameter choice; block if fitting rank is below 32

numeric_contract.tokenizer: lowercase then regex [a-z][a-z0-9]+; no stopword removal or stemming
numeric_contract.vocabulary: fit only on current training rows; descending document frequency with ascending lexical ties; take at most 5000 terms
numeric_contract.idf: log((1+N)/(1+df))+1, fitted on current training rows only
numeric_contract.normalization: L2 row normalization of TF-IDF before SVD
numeric_contract.empty_after_tokenization: exclude event from all arms before splitting, with reason EMPTY_LEXICAL_DOCUMENT
numeric_contract.all_terms_out_of_vocabulary: retain an all-zero lexical input and record OOV_ONLY; transform to zero SVD coordinates without imputation
numeric_contract.zero_tfidf_training_row: fail and review common sample before any fit

svd.input: train-only TF-IDF matrix after row L2 normalization
svd.solver: numpy.linalg.svd(full_matrices=False) on a dense float64 matrix; no randomized algorithm
svd.component_score: X @ V_k.T; equivalent to U_k times singular values on the training matrix
svd.failure: block if numerical rank < 32, nonfinite singular values, nonconvergence, or singular values 32 and 33 are indistinguishable within rank tolerance
svd.component_sign: for each row of V_k, make the largest-absolute-loading coordinate positive; ties use the lowest feature index
svd.repeat_policy: one deterministic fit per allowed training window; log library and BLAS versions; any randomized replacement requires a new proposed contract

dense.normalization: L2-normalize each chunk, equal-mean the chunk vectors, then L2-normalize the filing vector
dense.fit_failure_policy: Block if the training embedding matrix has fewer than 32 supported components

pca.dtype: float64 after conversion from the pinned stored embedding dtype
pca.centering: subtract the training-only column mean; do not scale input embedding coordinates before PCA
pca.solver: numpy.linalg.svd(full_matrices=False) on the centered dense training matrix; no randomized algorithm
pca.failure: block if numerical rank < 32, nonfinite singular values, nonconvergence, or singular values 32 and 33 are indistinguishable within rank tolerance
pca.component_sign: for each row of V_k, make the largest-absolute-loading coordinate positive; ties use the lowest embedding-coordinate index
pca.repeat_policy: one deterministic fit per allowed training window; fixed encoder reruns are runtime checks, not independent training seeds

prediction_arms.F1: F0 plus 32 train-only lexical SVD coordinates
prediction_arms.F2: F0 plus 32 train-only dense PCA coordinates
prediction_arms.predictor: ridge regression with intercept and train-only mean/standard-deviation scaling (ddof=0); drop zero-variance coordinates using the training window
prediction_arms.hyperparameter_choice: lowest validation MSE; exact ties choose the largest alpha
prediction_arms.tuning_budget: same three alpha candidates for each arm; no test-set setting selection

numeric_contract.standardization: training-window mean and population standard deviation (ddof=0), fitted separately within each arm; drop train-zero-variance columns and record indices; refit on permitted train+validation only
numeric_contract.ridge_objective: minimize sum_i (y_i - intercept - x_i dot beta)^2 + alpha * sum_j beta_j^2 on standardized coordinates
numeric_contract.alpha_loss_scale: sum of squared errors, not mean squared error
numeric_contract.solver: deterministic float64 numpy.linalg.lstsq(rcond=None) on an augmented design with sqrt(alpha) coefficient penalty rows and an unpenalized intercept column
numeric_contract.failure: nonfinite feature/label, empty eligible split, linear solve failure or undefined validation score blocks all three-arm comparison; do not zero-fill or report a partial winner
numeric_contract.repeat_policy: one deterministic fit for each of the three alpha values in each arm, then one permitted final refit per arm; no test-based rerun or seed selection

chronology.purge: A training label used for fitting must end and be finalized before the first validation decision; a validation label used for alpha selection or refit must end and be finalized before the first test decision; otherwise purge the event from that fit or validation set
chronology.refit: After validation selection, refit transforms and predictor on permitted training plus validation events whose labels are available before the first test decision

metrics.primary: F2 versus F0 common-row out-of-sample squared-error reduction: 1 - SSE(F2)/SSE(F0); undefined if the F0 denominator is zero
secondary: 1-SSE(F1)/SSE(F0) and 1-SSE(F2)/SSE(F1) on identical test events; null if a reference SSE is zero
MAE(F0)-MAE(F2) and MAE(F1)-MAE(F2) on identical test events; positive means F2 has lower absolute error

mean of defined calendar-month cross-sectional Spearman correlations, equal-weighting months with at least five distinct eligible firms; use the earliest eligible original filing per firm-month for this secondary metric, average ranks for exact ties, null month for constant predictions or labels, no fill
metrics.aggregation_unit: distinct original filing event; firm and calendar-time dependence must be reported
metrics.economic_value: NOT_ESTIMATED; a separate accepted trading, execution and cost protocol would be required

undefined_and_failure_policy.reference_sse_zero: null with reason; do not divide or replace with zero
undefined_and_failure_policy.monthly_spearman_constant_or_too_few_fir: null month with reason, omitted from defined-month mean with numerator and denominator reported
undefined_and_failure_policy.nonfinite_prediction_or_label: fail affected arm and common-row comparison before scoring; retain failure ledger
undefined_and_failure_policy.comparison_completion: do not report a complete F0/F1/F2 result if any required arm, row, transform or score is unavailable

execution_gates: Researcher freezes this protocol version and its data/vintage/exclusion choices
Point-in-time security master and filing/publication/revision evidence are available
Historical prices, identifiers and delisting/corporate-action policy cover the full feature and label windows
Exact model-time limitations and retrospective interpretation are accepted
All three arms use identical event rows and a chronological, purged split
A historical CIK-to-security primary-listing rule and effective-date identity must be verified before joining prices
A 21-session alternative must use its own fixed endpoint and is not the old 20-session local check
Numerical rank and both transform fits must pass in the training and permitted refit windows before any test score
Source-supported event-time CIK relation, primary issue and applicable market are required; candidate observation edges are insufficient
Both exact text and finalized d close must meet the proposed 18:00 ET availability gate or the event is excluded with reason

date_coverage_contract.position_reference: first session strictly after official filing date, then exactly h subsequent positions on an independent bound exchange calendar for a confirmed session pair
date_coverage_contract.without_independent_calendar: The saved retrospective XNYS baseline is not event-market confirmation; report baseline-axis positions only and leave market-confirmed observations null.
date_coverage_contract.missing_price: keep the d+h endpoint fixed on the reference axis; any missing required session price blocks that event and must not shift the endpoint
date_coverage_contract.required_future_window_prices: require a finite positive close for every reference-axis session from d through d+h inclusive; no gap skipping or endpoint substitution

horizon_mask_choice.impact: The first uses different 5- and 21-session observation sets; the second changes the five-session target population.

design_review.required_price_window: finite positive close at every fixed session from d-20 through d+h, including d; missing sessions do not shift endpoints
design_review.trade_close_field_preference: DlyClose; no automatic DlyPrc quote fallback
design_review.unit_and_claim: CIK company filing event with source-supported date-valid primary security; retrospective fixed-byte comparison, not historical tradability

identity_gate.why_blocked: CIK-CUSIP first/last filing observations do not establish continuous validity or company-level primary issue

clock.rule: 18:00 America/New_York on the first regular trading session strictly after the official filing date, conditional on proof that the exact text and finalized d close bar were available by 18:00; otherwise the event is ineligible with a recorded reason

design_review.missing_exit_interpretation: Preserve original broad company cohort and exit-source gate; no complete-case substitution or survivor-only silent deletion
design_review.sixty_session_primary_alternative: UNACCEPTED; the held 2019-11 to 2019-12 buffer cannot be presumed to cover 60 predecision sessions for early-2020 events
minimum_missing_roles: date-supported CIK-security relation at each event
dated company-primary issue and applicable market evidence
original accession/fiscal period/Item1 version and 18:00 text/close evidence
accepted traded-close adjustment, distribution, exit and common-mask rules
design_review.conclusion_limit: No company-level admitted count or financial comparison until identity, clock, label and full protocol gates pass
